scores.tell: Slightly uniform gloss on gold rims and cymbals; otherwise the podium and radial burst match the carousel card
Navy-on-blue lamp is slightly heavy and dark, and the coloured beams are a little cinematic
Neon pink/cyan glassy gel glow on electric blue rays; no matte local colour like the real cards
Umbrella panels are slightly puffy and inflated, a touch toy-like
Dense, hard metallic truss lattice across the top with crisp specular glints; too realistic and busy
Hard horizon split between the gradient wall and a pale peach floor looks staged; the long cast shadow is a touch realistic
Pale washed-out airbrushed white unit, cropped on a wall in forced perspective, with weak value separation
Saddle leather is slightly dark and plump compared with the grade-5 saddle
Full desert landscape with clouds and pebbles plus a cool grey realistic dish gradient; more scene-like than real cards
Calculator body is a slightly fat pillow slab with puffy rounded corners
